headline: Awami League leaders harass Muhammad Yunus at New York airport
summary: The Nobel laureate was mobbed by banned AL leaders while leaving JFK airport in a wheelchair; the interim government vows legal action.
details: Several leaders of the Awami League, whose activities are currently banned in Bangladesh, are accused of harassing Muhammad Yunus at New York's John F Kennedy Airport.
The Nobel laureate was mobbed as he left the airport in a wheelchair on Monday at 3:45pm local time, accompanied by Lamiya Morshed of the Yunus Centre.
A circulating video shows Imdad Chowdhury, general secretary of the New York Metropolitan Awami League, and Mizanur Rahman Chowdhury of the US Jubo League, among others, confronting Yunus.
The group shouted accusations, calling him a terrorist and claiming he had killed thousands of people and destroyed democracy in Bangladesh.
The interim government's information advisor has stated that legal action will be taken regarding the harassment incident.
Separately, Yunus had recently cancelled his visit to the World Health Summit in Berlin for health reasons, following objections from some Europe-based organisations.
The Bangladesh Mission in New York and the Yunus Centre have not yet provided official statements on the airport incident.
caption:
Mobbed in a wheelchair: Awami League leaders confront Muhammad Yunus at JFK airport.

Several leaders of the Awami League, whose activities are currently banned in Bangladesh, are accused of harassing Muhammad Yunus at New York's John F Kennedy Airport.

The Nobel laureate was mobbed as he left the airport in a wheelchair on Monday at 3:45pm local time, accompanied by Lamiya Morshed of the Yunus Centre.

A circulating video shows Imdad Chowdhury, general secretary of the New York Metropolitan Awami League, and Mizanur Rahman Chowdhury of the US Jubo League, among others, confronting Yunus.

The group shouted accusations, calling him a terrorist and claiming he had killed thousands of people and destroyed democracy in Bangladesh.

The interim government's information advisor has stated that legal action will be taken regarding the harassment incident.

Separately, Yunus had recently cancelled his visit to the World Health Summit in Berlin for health reasons, following objections from some Europe-based organisations.

The Bangladesh Mission in New York and the Yunus Centre have not yet provided official statements on the airport incident.

headline: Crude bombs explode outside Madaripur judge's home
summary: Several explosions occurred near Shakuni Lake early Tuesday morning, according to local police.
details: Several crude bombs exploded outside the residence of the district and sessions judge in Madaripur town early Tuesday morning.
The explosions took place near Shakuni Lake, as confirmed by Abul Kalam Azad, chief of Madaripur Sadar Model Police Station.
Local reports indicate that a gathering of the NCP was scheduled to take place at the same location later in the afternoon.
caption:
